nodes.label: Must beat the current 2D game
nodes.rationale: New frame next to the current 2D frame for the same state; if not visibly stronger in the game scene (not only in a large concept) the verdict is FAIL.

nodes.label: Placeholders never count as final art
nodes.rationale: Flat shapes, procedural stand-ins and unapproved generated images must be named as placeholders; ChatGPT concepts are neural generations and stay unapproved until the owner decides.

nodes.label: Packed check via Godot --export-pack from outside source tree
tools/build_pck.py not used for packed check
nodes.rationale: It packs raw PNG files without import remaps, so every imported texture fails to load from its pack.

nodes.label: Report lists human checks automation cannot cover
macOS universal ad-hoc build and verification
FLUX creature art pass (magenta backdrop cutout)
Border-connected flood fill keying
nodes.rationale: Backdrop hue is not fixed (314-343 deg in one batch), so it is measured per image from the border and only border-connected pixels are cleared; this also removes baked shadow and keeps enclosed hot-pink details.

nodes.label: Exporter packs every .gd regardless of exclude_filter
nodes.rationale: tests/ and tools/ shipped inside the .pck; fix is to stash both dirs during export with an EXIT trap.

nodes.label: No Accessibility or Screen Recording permission constraint
nodes.rationale: Agent could only inject engine-level events and capture the app viewport; scripted bot outcome is not proof of human playability.

nodes.label: Blender Cycles AO bake with 3x3 tiled copies
High-frequency grain band fix
nodes.rationale: Tile had 34% contrast but all in ~200 px patches so it read as a smooth gradient at 1:1; additive blending produced camouflage so grain is multiplicative with a bias below 1.0.

nodes.label: Pools never recycled once the wall was removed
nodes.rationale: Orbs and enemies were never despawned in the endless world, saturating pools and stopping spawn near the player; _cleanup_pools releases items past the fog.

nodes.label: Regalia need dark outline, accent and highlight layers
nodes.rationale: Ornaments are judged on a clean background at enlarged radius because on the game frame floor, props and grade make verdicts guesswork.

nodes.label: Silent clamp/threshold bugs in the ladder
nodes.rationale: Ladder top threshold sat above the mass ceiling and play_sfx pitch clamp [0.55,1.75] made stages 10-15 sound identical; check where a growth formula saturates.

nodes.label: Textures only via AssetRegistry.get_texture, never load()
nodes.rationale: ResourceLoader sees PNG only when a .import bridge to .godot/imported exists; raw packs have no bridge so load() returns null and art is silently lost.

nodes.label: Biome field as one RGBA texture with two readers
nodes.rationale: Two noise implementations drift apart; anything that must agree across the render boundary should read one resource.

nodes.label: Wall-clock frame time not measurable here
nodes.rationale: VSYNC-disabled still reads 16.67 ms and headless has a 6.9 ms floor even for an empty scene; only self-timers are reported.

nodes.label: Measuring tools must restore settings they change
nodes.rationale: audio_peak_probe left volumes at 1.0 in the real save and distorted its own reports.

nodes.label: Three plan documents outrank older roadmaps
nodes.rationale: Owner designated them the basis on 25.10.2026; reading them is not a command to start phases.

nodes.label: Image generation via browser ChatGPT only
nodes.rationale: Owner preference; if unavailable report the blocker, do not switch generator.

Relaxation direction: beautiful world, simple mechanics

nodes.rationale: Do not treat plans, test counts or another agent message as proof; label unknowns.

nodes.label: Never load textures via load()/ResourceLoader
nodes.rationale: In a raw pack the PNG exists but the import bridge does not, load() returns null without error and the material falls back, so art is lost silently.

nodes.label: World art: floor layers and props
Pool cleanup past fog distance
nodes.rationale: The arena wall was implicitly making pools self-clean; removing it required _cleanup_pools or spawning silently stops.

nodes.rationale: Resolution-independent and maintainable; painted textures would need an artist pipeline.
